cli.cmd.init: Initialize a new YYDB database file
cli.cmd.webui: Open the browser WebUI for a database
cli.opt.endpoint: Existing wire endpoint (skip spawning yydb serve)
cli.opt.no-open: Do not open a browser tab
cli.cmd.verify: Run read-only consistency probes and report findings
cli.opt.schema-file: VOS schema document to embed at init time
cli.opt.doctor: Include doctor consistency probes in info output

yydb.doctor.wal_overlap: WAL frame {seq} overlaps the main file region
yydb.doctor.wal_lost: Last checkpoint {cp_seq} newer than last WAL frame {wal_seq}
yydb.doctor.schema_desync: Schema version {db_ver} newer than embedded descriptor {doc_ver}

yydb.verify.has_warnings: Doctor found {n} warning(s). The database is readable but should be inspected.
yydb.verify.has_errors: Doctor found {n} error(s). The database may be corrupt.
